articles.title: Rate plans from Trump's Fed candidates may not be so different
articles.mainIdea: Rate plans from Trump's Fed candidates may not be so different
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Rate plans from Trump's Fed candidates may not be so different. President Trump's hinted that he was going to announce his nominee to be the next chair of the Federal Reserve very soon in his address at the World Economic Forum (WEF) last week. In fact, Wall Street believes an announcement could be coming as soon as this week.Prediction markets have swung in favor of BlackRock's (BLK) head of fixed income Rick Rieder.BofA Securities Senior U.S. Economist Stephen Juneau weighs in on whether a new Fed chair would change the narrative around interest rate policy for regulators. The US central bank is scheduled to release its first interest rate decision of 2026 this Wednesday, January 28.Be sure to check out Jennifer Schonberger's profiles on each of the possible candidates to be the next Fed chair: National Economic Council director Kevin Hassett, former Fed Governor Kevin Warsh, Fed Governor Chris Waller, Fed Vice Chair of Supervision Michelle Bowman, and BlackRock's Rick Rieder.To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

articles.title: BlackRock Files S-1 for Bitcoin Premium Income ETF as Crypto ETPs See $1.73B in Outflows
articles.mainIdea: BlackRock Files S-1 for Bitcoin Premium Income ETF as Crypto ETPs See $1.73B in Outflows
articles.summary: CoinGape: BlackRock Files S-1 for Bitcoin Premium Income ETF as Crypto ETPs See $1.73B in Outflows. The world’s largest asset manager, BlackRock, has filed the registration statement for its Bitcoin Premium Income ETF with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). This move comes just as crypto ETPs log their largest weekly outflows since November last year. BlackRock Files Registration Statement For Upcoming Bitcoin ETF An SEC filing shows that the Related tickers mentioned: BTC-USD, IBIT.

articles.summary: Business Wire: Thematic Investing and Credit Risk Research Honored with Graham and Dodd Awards of Excellence. NEW YORK, January 26, 2026--CFA Institute, the global association of investment professionals, today announced the winners of the Graham and Dodd Awards of Excellence, recognizing the most outstanding research articles published in the CFA Institute Financial Analysts Journal during the year.
